description: Defines the Model_SPM struct which stores matrices and parameters for the spatial discretisation of the solid diffusion PDE in a battery modeling context. It includes data members for matrices, vectors, and input parameters, and reads data from CSV files during construction.

classes.name: Model_SPM
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates matrices and parameters for the spatial discretisation of the solid diffusion PDE, including methods for initialization from CSV files.

methods.name: makeModel
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton instance of Model_SPM.
